## SK Group Chairman Ordered to Pay ~$640–645M in South Korea's Largest-Ever Divorce Settlement

Controlling-shareholder personal financial stress at this scale can create share-pledge overhang or governance uncertainty at SK Hynix — worth monitoring for any forced-sale signaling, particularly given the current AI memory cycle tailwind that has elevated the stock.

- A South Korean court ordered SK Group's chairman to pay a divorce settlement; outlets report figures ranging from approximately $640M to $645M — the exact amount differs across coverage.
- The settlement is described uniformly as the largest divorce award in South Korean history, with multiple outlets using the phrase 'divorce of the century.'
- The chairman is SK Group's controlling shareholder, linking the personal liability to potential governance and share-pledge concerns at SK Hynix.
- Headlines indicate no direct operating or financial impact on SK Hynix's business.
